remarks:
Welcome to 8204 Peavey Road. This property offers a unique opportunity for a cabin retreat or future home near abundant state land for hunting at Allen Lake and not far from Rushford Lake.
This converted Amish schoolhouse features an open floor plan, vinyl siding and metal roof
providing a blank canvas to finish and customize to your preferences.
The cabin includes a full basement, offering excellent access for wiring, plumbing, and additional build-out. With approximately 24’ x 32’ of space, there is room to create a comfortable residence or weekend getaway.
Situated on a 200’ x 200’ lot, the property offers low-maintenance grounds and a manageable footprint. A shed is located at the rear of the property for added storage, and power is available approximately 50 feet across the road.
